decision_reason: The executable safety and liveness evidence is strong enough to retain as a mandatory CI gate, but the wire/storage contracts are still changing around real WebAuthn state, credential lifecycle, verified assertion receipts, exactly-once approval append, and provider-specific execution. Promoting now would freeze an incomplete boundary.

artifact_dispositions.reason: Add explicit governance credential lifecycle and verified assertion receipt boundaries after DEN-493, DEN-494, and DEN-496.
Update fixtures only after the revised credential and verified-receipt contracts stabilize.
Reference authorization semantics are valuable as a fail-closed oracle but should not become generated SDK runtime code.
The bounded state model is verification evidence, not a wire contract.
Keep transition wire fields draft until evidence, notice, recovery, and legal-attestation boundaries are reviewed end to end.
Regenerate examples after the final transition and recovery schema disposition.
Transition semantics remain a CI oracle and counterexample surface.
Provider-neutral fencing, idempotency, reconciliation, and drift semantics remain mandatory test evidence.
Death and succession paths model technical process only and must not become an SDK claim about legal authority.
Version-domain and migration rules govern future promotion and rollback.
The bounded explorer is permanent promotion evidence and should remain in CI.
The assumptions and exclusions must remain visible beside every future promotion decision.

requirements: retain the previous schema index and generated outputs
dual-read before any new write format is enabled
do not rewrite signed historical objects
disable new writes before reader rollback
verify historical receipts under their original contract version
